records.text: Nika reported a total memory blackout from ages four to ten while living at Fort Hood.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep X92MllIHDzw)

appearances.snippet: Total memory blackout from ages 4 to 10, the exact years, because I was responding to a comment of somebody else who had a memory blackout being a part of this program. The exact years that I was at Fort Hood on base. Later 80s, late, later 80s, early 90s, military brat, dad was a doctor doing residency adjacent to a bio lab at the army hospital. I wouldn't follow protocol as a kid after the program.

verification.notes: The episode transcript confirms that Owens read a viewer report attributed to Nika describing a memory blackout from ages four to ten at Fort Hood. This verifies that Nika was reported as saying it, not the underlying autobiographical memory claim.

records.text: Nika reported attending four schools later discovered to be connected to the Department of Defense through the Aspen Education Group.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep X92MllIHDzw)

appearances.snippet: And so after the army, I got shuffled through four different schools that I later discovered are all connected to the DOD through the Aspen Education Group. I think they changed the name. I have docs, but yeah. And shell companies. I've gone through hell and back with loads of FOIAs to my name, just trying to figure out what happened to me at Turnabout Ranch in Escalante, Utah.

verification.notes: The episode transcript confirms that the same viewer report attributed to Nika claimed four schools were connected to the Department of Defense through Aspen Education Group. The alleged institutional connections are not independently established.
